identity.title: Move ROI Image Canvas path policy to the existing directory-policy owner

origin.summary: The user requested that Partial refactoring continue in scheduled cycles and that remaining responsibilities be corrected structurally.

state.current_summary: RoiImageCanvasViewModel의 파일명 추출과 기본 PNG 저장 이름 정책을 기존 ImageCanvasDirectoryPolicy로 이동했다. ViewModel의 Mat/ROI/OpenGL/input/timer 상태와 수명 소유권은 유지했으며, 새 Partial이나 추상화는 추가하지 않았다. Debug/Release 계약·빌드와 정적 검증이 통과했고 WPF/native runtime은 미검증으로 남겼다.

objective.summary: Move the pure image-name and default-save-name policy out of RoiImageCanvasViewModel into the existing ImageCanvasDirectoryPolicy while preserving the public canvas facade, mutable state, resource lifetime, and dialog/save behavior.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Reuse ImageCanvasDirectoryPolicy; do not add a service, interface, wrapper, registry, or Partial.
Preserve RoiImageCanvasViewModel bindings, LoadImage/SaveCurrentImage contracts, Mat ownership, input-controller lifetime, and dialog semantics.
Keep test outputs and evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or mutate the Original repository.

criteria.text: The proof report records current and intended owners, the call path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, binding/public contract, shortest reading order, and matching test.
ImageCanvasDirectoryPolicy owns image-name extraction and default-save-name sanitization, and RoiImageCanvasViewModel delegates both paths without a System.IO path import or private duplicate policy.
Focused Debug/Release contracts, relevant Debug/Release builds, readiness, structural audit, documentation index, and diff checks pass; WPF/native runtime limits are explicitly recorded.

milestones.summary: Freeze the ROI Image Canvas caller, mutable-state, binding, and lifetime contract.
Move pure image-name and default-save-name policy to ImageCanvasDirectoryPolicy without changing the ViewModel facade.
Run focused Debug/Release proof and record durable evidence and navigation documentation.

evidence.observation: ImageCanvasDirectoryPolicy owns ResolveImageName and CreateDefaultSaveFileName. The ViewModel delegates both LoadImage name assignments and the save-dialog default name, while keeping _currentImageName, Mat, ImageViewer, input controllers, timer, bindings, and Dispose ownership.
RoiImageCanvasPathPolicyContract passed 6/6 in Debug and Release. Existing RoiImageCanvasBoundaryContract also passed 6/6 in both configurations.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke and OpenVisionLab.sln Debug/Release builds passed with 0 warnings/errors; OpenVisionReadinessCheck Debug/Release, RefactorAudit -Verify, TestDocumentationIndex, and git diff --check passed.

events.summary: RoiImageCanvasViewModel의 공유 Mat/ROI/OpenGL/input/timer 상태와 수명을 새 모듈로 분리할 독립 seam은 확인되지 않았으므로 기존 owner는 유지한다. 순수 파일명 정책만 이미 존재하는 ImageCanvasDirectoryPolicy로 이동하고 새 추상화는 만들지 않는다.
PL-0033의 세 completion criteria와 세 milestone이 현재 증거로 충족되어 resolved로 닫는다. WPF visual/theme/DPI/monitor/input, OpenGL, hardware/native runtime은 이 소스 slice의 검증 범위가 아니다.

Owner proof, concrete responsibility move, focused Debug/Release verification, and durable documentation completed. Do not reopen this owner without a new requirement, reproducible defect, failed criterion, or changed dependency boundary.
